versions.subject: fix: FPs found in win2022 domain controller baseline
versions.detection:
selection:
  Image|endswith: '\explorer.exe'
  CommandLine|contains: '/NOUACCHECK'
filter_dc_logon:
  - ParentCommandLine: 'C:\Windows\system32\svchost.exe -k netsvcs -p -s Schedule'
  - ParentImage: 'C:\Windows\System32\svchost.exe'  # coarse filter needed for ID 4688 Events
condition: selection and not 1 of filter_*
versions.spl: Image="*\\explorer.exe" CommandLine="*/NOUACCHECK*" NOT (ParentCommandLine="C:\\Windows\\system32\\svchost.exe -k netsvcs -p -s Schedule" OR ParentImage="C:\\Windows\\System32\\svchost.exe")
